description: Figure 8(c) illustrates the branching ratio γB across varying numbers of few-shot examples. The horizontal axis, labeled “Number of Shots,” displays categories ranging from 1 to 8, presented in ascending order. The vertical axis, labeled “Branching Ratio γB,” represents values on a linear scale from 0.00 to 1.00, with tick labels at 0.0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8, and 1.0. Three distinct colored lines are displayed, each representing a different condition: “zero-shot” in a solid blue line, “one-shot” in a dashed red line, and “five-shot” in a dash-dot green line. The “zero-shot” line begins at approximately 0.25 and increases to approximately 0.75. The “one-shot” line starts at approximately 0.4 and rises to approximately 0.85. The “five-shot” line begins at approximately 0.6 and increases to approximately 0.95. All three lines demonstrate an increasing trend as the number of shots increases.
